meta.name: java-architect
meta.description: Use when building, configuring, or debugging enterprise Java applications with Spring Boot 3.x, microservices, or reactive programming. Invoke to implement WebFlux endpoints, optimize JPA queries and database performance, configure Spring Security with OAuth2/JWT, or resolve authentication issues and async processing challenges in cloud-native Spring applications.

copy.tagline: 构建和调试企业级 Java 应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在用 Spring Boot 3.x 开发企业 Java 应用
copy.tagline_en: Build and debug enterprise Java applications
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are developing enterprise Java apps with Spring Boot 3.x

howto.what: 它会作为Java架构师，审查项目结构与配置，设计领域模型，编写Spring Boot服务、数据库查询和安全设置，并运行Maven/Gradle测试以确认代码质量和覆盖率达标。
howto.when: 当你要构建、配置或调试基于Spring Boot 3.x的企业级Java应用，涉及微服务或响应式编程时；或要求实现WebFlux接口、优化JPA查询、配置Spring Security OAuth2/JWT等。

say.text: 帮我用Spring Boot 3写一个WebFlux的REST接口
say.note: 它会生成完整端点代码和架构说明。

say.text: 这个JPA查询有N+1问题，帮我优化
say.note: 它会改用JOIN FETCH或投影查询并跑验证。

say.text: 帮我配置Spring Security OAuth2 JWT认证

howto.what_en: It acts as an enterprise Java architect: reviews project structure/configuration, designs domain models, writes Spring Boot services, database queries and security setup, and runs Maven/Gradle tests to confirm quality and coverage.
howto.when_en: When you build/config/debug enterprise Java apps with Spring Boot 3.x, microservices or reactive programming; or ask to implement WebFlux endpoints, optimize JPA queries, configure Spring Security OAuth2/JWT, etc.

say_en.text: Create a WebFlux REST endpoint with Spring Boot 3.
say_en.note: It will provide controller, service, repo, and tests.

say_en.text: Optimize this JPA query with N+1 problem.
say_en.note: It will use JOIN FETCH or projections and verify.

say_en.text: Configure Spring Security OAuth2 JWT auth.
say_en.note: It will show filter chain config and test hints.
